steps.message:
# RL training run diagnosis

Review the staged post-training experiment and determine whether it is healthy
or unhealthy. Treat the workspace as a historical snapshot: inspect its source,
effective configuration, launch scripts, data processing, reward logic, logs,
tracked metrics, and frozen evaluation evidence. Do not assume that an unusual
setting or implementation is causal without connecting it to observed behavior.

Use held-out evaluation evidence together with rollout, truncation, runtime,
optimization, and training signals. Training reward alone does not establish
held-out health. A truncated log is not by itself proof of a defect.

Do not launch a full training run, use the network, or modify the historical
snapshot. The dataset, held-out set, model, training-step budget, and evaluation
interval are fixed.

## Deliverable

Write one concise UTF-8 diagnosis to:

```text
$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/agent_answer.md
```

State the verdict, identify the concrete root cause or causes, and explain the
causal chain using specific workspace evidence. Distinguish root causes from
symptoms. Do not propose or implement a fix, and do not write other deliverable
files.
I’ll trace the configured training and evaluation pipeline, then reconcile it with rollout and frozen held-out evidence before writing the diagnosis.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat, decoupled PPO with IcePop token masking on GSM8K (AReaL, local scheduler).
# 3 epochs = 87 steps on one 8-GPU node: 4 SGLang rollout servers + 4 FSDP actor ranks
# (the allocation and every other default come from examples/math/gsm8k_icepop.yaml).
# The recorded run resolved the model and dataset by hub id from an offline cache
# (actor.path=Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat, dataset path openai/gsm8k, see config.yaml);
# here they point at the local copies that environment/prepare.sh places in the workspace.
set -euo pipefail
W="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$W"
export PYTHONPATH="$W${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"

SEED="${SEED:-2}"
RLROOT="${RLROOT:-$W/run}"
MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-$W/models/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat}"
DATA_PATH="${DATA_PATH:-$W/data/gsm8k}"
mkdir -p "$RLROOT/experiments" "$RLROOT/name_resolve" "$RLROOT/logs"

export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export AREAL_ALLOW_DEFAULT_ADMIN_KEY=1
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
# Per-token logprob dumps (inference-engine / proximal / current), every 20th call.
export KT_DUMP_DIR="$RLROOT/ktdump/seeds_icepop_w067_s${SEED}"
export KT_DUMP_EVERY=20
# Only read by disk-mode weight updates; this run syncs weights over NCCL (xccl).
export KT_WEIGHT_UPDATE_DIR="/dev/shm/${USER:-root}-wu-$$"

python examples/math/gsm8k_rl.py \
    --config examples/math/gsm8k_icepop.yaml \
    experiment_name=kt-seeds \
    trial_name=icepop_w067-s${SEED} \
    seed=$SEED \
    scheduler.type=local \
    cluster.fileroot="$RLROOT/experiments" \
    cluster.name_resolve.nfs_record_root="$RLROOT/name_resolve" \
    actor.path="$MODEL_PATH" \
    train_dataset.path="$DATA_PATH" \
    valid_dataset.path="$DATA_PATH" \
    actor.optimizer.lr=3e-6 \
    actor.optimizer.weight_decay=0.01 \
    ++actor.eps_clip=0.2 \
    ++actor.eps_clip_higher=0.28 \
    actor.mb_spec.max_tokens_per_mb=4096 \
    ref.mb_spec.max_tokens_per_mb=4096 \
    ++train_dataset.setup_timeout=900 \
    ++valid_dataset.setup_timeout=900 \
    ++rollout.setup_timeout=900 \
    total_train_epochs=3 \
    actor.weight_update_mode=xccl \
    actor.request_timeout=3600 \
    rollout.request_timeout=3600 \
    vllm.disable_custom_all_reduce=false \
    actor.rejection_sampling.lower=0.67 \
    actor.rejection_sampling.upper=1.5

experiment_name: boba_grpo
trial_name: trial0

seed: 1
enable_offload: false
total_train_epochs: 10
tokenizer_path: ${actor.path}

cluster:
  n_nodes: 1
  n_gpus_per_node: 8
  fileroot: /tmp/areal/experiments
  name_resolve:
    type: nfs
    nfs_record_root: /tmp/areal/name_resolve


scheduler:
  type: null

rollout:
  backend: "vllm:d4"
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  max_concurrent_rollouts: 64
  queue_size: null
  consumer_batch_size: ${train_dataset.batch_size}
  max_head_offpolicyness: 4
  enable_rollout_tracing: true
  scheduling_spec: ${actor.scheduling_spec}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  tokenizer_path: ${tokenizer_path}
  dump_to_file: true
  agent:
    mode: inline
    export_style: individual
    turn_discount: 1.0

gconfig:
  n_samples: 16
  min_new_tokens: 0
  max_new_tokens: 8192
  max_tokens: 2048
  greedy: false
  temperature: 1.0

actor:
  backend: "fsdp:d4"
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B
  init_from_scratch: false
  disable_dropout: true
  gradient_checkpointing: true
  dtype: bfloat16
  mb_spec:
    max_tokens_per_mb: 16384
  optimizer:
    type: adam
    lr: 1e-5
    weight_decay: 0.01
    beta1: 0.9
    beta2: 0.999
    eps: 1e-8
    lr_scheduler_type: constant
    gradient_clipping: 1.0
    warmup_steps_proportion: 0.001
  eps_clip: 0.4
  temperature: ${gconfig.temperature}
  reward_scaling: 10.0
  reward_bias: -0.5
  kl_ctl: 0.0
  ppo_n_minibatches: 4
  recompute_logprob: true
  use_decoupled_loss: true
  rejection_sampling:
    metric: ratio
    upper: 5.0
  reward_norm:
    mean_level: group
    std_level: group
    group_size: ${gconfig.n_samples}
  adv_norm:
    mean_level: batch
    std_level: batch
  max_new_tokens: ${gconfig.max_new_tokens}
  scheduling_spec:
    - task_type: worker
      port_count: 2
      gpu: 1
      mem: 32
      cmd: python3 -m areal.infra.rpc.rpc_server
      env_vars:
        VLLM_USE_V1: "1"
        VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN: "1"
        TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE: "2"
        HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT: "14400"
        HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE: "HOST"
        ACL_DEVICE_SYNC_TIMEOUT: "14400"
        HCCL_EVENT_TIMEOUT: "14500"
        HCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING: "0"
        ACL_STREAM_TIMEOUT: "14500000"
        HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT: "7200"
        PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF: "expandable_segments:True"

ref:
  backend: ${actor.backend}
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  path: ${actor.path}
  init_from_scratch: false
  disable_dropout: true
  dtype: ${actor.dtype}
  mb_spec:
    max_tokens_per_mb: 16384
  optimizer: null
  scheduling_strategy:
    type: colocation
    target: actor
  scheduling_spec: ${actor.scheduling_spec}

sglang:
  model_path: ${actor.path}
  random_seed: ${seed}
  skip_tokenizer_init: true
  dtype: ${actor.dtype}
  max_running_requests: null
  context_length: 32768
  mem_fraction_static: 0.9

vllm:
  model: ${actor.path}
  seed: ${seed}
  skip_tokenizer_init: false
  dtype: ${actor.dtype}
  max_model_len: 32768
  gpu_memory_utilization: 0.9

# datasets
train_dataset:
  path: inclusionAI/AReaL-boba-Data
  batch_size: 32
  pin_memory: true
  type: rl

# Utilities
saver:
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  freq_epochs: 1
  freq_steps: null
  freq_secs: null

recover:
  mode: disabled
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  freq_epochs: 1
  freq_steps: null
  freq_secs: 3600
  retries: 0

evaluator:
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  freq_epochs: null
  freq_steps: null
  freq_secs: null

stats_logger:
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  wandb:
    mode: disabled

perf_tracer:
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  enabled: true
  session_tracer:
    enabled: true

import sys

from datasets import load_dataset

from areal import PPOTrainer
from areal.api.cli_args import GRPOConfig, load_expr_config
from areal.reward import get_math_verify_worker
from areal.utils.hf_utils import apply_chat_template, load_hf_tokenizer


def get_input_ids_fn(data, tokenizer, enable_thinking):
    user_token = "<｜User｜>"
    assistant_token = "<｜Assistant｜>"
    think_token = "<think>"
    has_think_token = think_token in data
    data = (
        data.replace(user_token, "")
        .replace(assistant_token, "")
        .replace(think_token, "")
    )
    input_ids = apply_chat_template(
        tokenizer,
        [{"role": "user", "content": data}],
        tokenize=True,
        add_generation_prompt=True,
        enable_thinking=enable_thinking or has_think_token,
    )
    return input_ids


def data_extract_prompt_fn(data):
    return data["prompt"]


def get_boba_math_dataset(path, tokenizer):
    dataset = load_dataset(
        path="json",
        split="train",
        data_files=path,
    )
    dataset = dataset.filter(lambda x: len(tokenizer.encode(x["prompt"])) <= 1024)
    return dataset


def boba_reward_fn(
    prompts, completions, prompt_ids, completion_ids, solutions, **kwargs
) -> float:
    try:
        worker = get_math_verify_worker()
        for sol in solutions:
            try:
                score = worker.verify(str(completions), str(sol))
                if score == 1.0:
                    return 1.0
            except Exception:
                pass
        return 0.0
    except Exception:
        # Return 0 if completion parsing fails or any other error occurs
        return 0.0


def main(args):
    config, _ = load_expr_config(args, GRPOConfig)
    tokenizer = load_hf_tokenizer(config.tokenizer_path)

    train_dataset = get_boba_math_dataset(config.train_dataset.path, tokenizer)

    workflow_kwargs = dict(
        reward_fn="examples.math.boba_grpo.boba_reward_fn",
        gconfig=config.gconfig,
        tokenizer=config.tokenizer_path,
        enable_thinking=True,
        get_input_ids_fn="examples.math.boba_grpo.get_input_ids_fn",
        data_extract_prompt_fn="examples.math.boba_grpo.data_extract_prompt_fn",
    )

    with PPOTrainer(
        config,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        valid_dataset=None,
    ) as trainer:
        trainer.train(
            workflow="areal.workflow.rlvr.RLVRWorkflow",
            workflow_kwargs=workflow_kwargs,
            eval_workflow=None,
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])

experiment_name: gsm8k-icepop
trial_name: trial0

seed: 1
enable_offload: false
total_train_epochs: 10
tokenizer_path: ${actor.path}

cluster:
  n_nodes: 1
  n_gpus_per_node: 8
  fileroot: /tmp/areal/experiments
  name_resolve:
    type: nfs
    nfs_record_root: /tmp/areal/name_resolve


scheduler:
  type: null

rollout:
  backend: "sglang:d4p1t1"
  request_timeout: 10800   # disk weight reload of 30B over NFS can exceed the 3600s default
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  max_concurrent_rollouts: 256
  queue_size: null
  consumer_batch_size: ${train_dataset.batch_size}
  max_head_offpolicyness: 2
  enable_rollout_tracing: false
  scheduling_spec: ${actor.scheduling_spec}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  tokenizer_path: ${tokenizer_path}
  dump_to_file: false
  agent:
    mode: inline
    export_style: individual
    turn_discount: 1.0

gconfig:
  n_samples: 4
  min_new_tokens: 0
  max_new_tokens: 1024
  max_tokens: 2048
  greedy: false
  temperature: 1.0

actor:
  backend: "fsdp:d4p1t1"
  request_timeout: 10800
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
  init_from_scratch: false
  disable_dropout: true
  gradient_checkpointing: true
  dtype: bfloat16
  mb_spec:
    max_tokens_per_mb: 10240
    packing_algorithm: ffd
  optimizer:
    type: adam
    lr: 1.70e-5
    weight_decay: 0.017
    beta1: 0.9
    beta2: 0.999
    eps: 1e-8
    lr_scheduler_type: constant
    gradient_clipping: 1.0
    warmup_steps_proportion: 0.001
  eps_clip: 0.4
  temperature: ${gconfig.temperature}
  reward_scaling: 10.0
  reward_bias: -0.5
  kl_ctl: 0.0
  ppo_n_minibatches: 1
  use_decoupled_loss: true
  rejection_sampling:
    level: token
    action: mask
    metric: ratio
    lower: 0.5
    upper: 5.0
  reward_norm:
    mean_level: group
    std_level: group
    group_size: ${gconfig.n_samples}
  adv_norm:
    mean_level: batch
    std_level: batch
  weight_update_mode: disk   # xccl to vLLM hangs (FSDP all-gather waits forever); disk reload works
  max_new_tokens: ${gconfig.max_new_tokens}
  scheduling_spec:
    - task_type: worker
      port_count: 2
      gpu: 1
      mem: 32
      cmd: python3 -m areal.infra.rpc.rpc_server
      env_vars: {}

ref:
  backend: ${actor.backend}
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  path: ${actor.path}
  init_from_scratch: false
  disable_dropout: true
  dtype: ${actor.dtype}
  mb_spec:
    max_tokens_per_mb: 10240
    packing_algorithm: ffd
  optimizer: null
  scheduling_strategy:
    type: colocation
    target: actor
  scheduling_spec: ${actor.scheduling_spec}

# SGLang
sglang:
  model_path: ${actor.path}
  random_seed: ${seed}
  skip_tokenizer_init: true
  dtype: ${actor.dtype}
  max_running_requests: null
  context_length: 32768
  mem_fraction_static: 0.8

vllm:
  model: ${actor.path}
  seed: ${seed}
  skip_tokenizer_init: false
  disable_custom_all_reduce: true
  dtype: ${actor.dtype}
  max_model_len: 32768
  gpu_memory_utilization: 0.8

# datasets
train_dataset:
  batch_size: 256
  shuffle: true
  pin_memory: true
  num_workers: 4
  path: openai/gsm8k
  type: rl
  max_length: 1024

valid_dataset:
  batch_size: 256
  pin_memory: true
  num_workers: 4
  path: openai/gsm8k
  type: rl

# Utilities
saver:
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  freq_epochs: 1
  freq_steps: null
  freq_secs: null

recover:
  mode: disabled
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  freq_epochs: 1
  freq_steps: null
  freq_secs: 3600

evaluator:
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  freq_epochs: 1
  freq_steps: null
  freq_secs: null

stats_logger:
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  wandb:
    mode: disabled

perf_tracer:
  experiment_name: ${experiment_name}
  trial_name: ${trial_name}
  fileroot: ${cluster.fileroot}
  enabled: false
  session_tracer:
    enabled: false

import sys

from areal import PPOTrainer
from areal.api.cli_args import GRPOConfig, load_expr_config
from areal.dataset import get_custom_dataset
from areal.utils.hf_utils import load_hf_tokenizer


def main(args):
    config, _ = load_expr_config(args, GRPOConfig)
    tokenizer = load_hf_tokenizer(config.tokenizer_path)

    train_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
        split="train",
        dataset_config=config.train_dataset,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
    )
    valid_dataset = get_custom_dataset(
        split="test",
        dataset_config=config.valid_dataset,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
    )

    workflow_kwargs = dict(
        temperature=config.gconfig.temperature,
        top_p=config.gconfig.top_p,
        max_tokens=config.gconfig.max_tokens,
        max_completion_tokens=config.gconfig.max_new_tokens,
    )
    eval_workflow_kwargs = workflow_kwargs.copy()
    eval_workflow_kwargs["temperature"] = 0.6

    with PPOTrainer(
        config,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        valid_dataset=valid_dataset,
    ) as trainer:
        trainer.train(
            workflow="areal.workflow.openai.math_agent.MathAgent",
            workflow_kwargs=workflow_kwargs,
            eval_workflow="areal.workflow.openai.math_agent.MathAgent",
            eval_workflow_kwargs=eval_workflow_kwargs,
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])

449	
450	        self.actor.connect_engine(self.rollout, self.weight_update_meta)
451

490	    @staticmethod
491	    def _is_colocation(strategy: SchedulingStrategy | None) -> bool:
492	        if strategy is None:
493	            return False
494	        return strategy.type in (
495	            SchedulingStrategyType.colocation,
496	            SchedulingStrategyType.colocation.value,
497	            "colocation",
498	        )

500	    def _is_actor_rollout_colocated(self, config: PPOConfig) -> bool:
501	        actor_s = config.actor.scheduling_strategy
502	        rollout_s = config.rollout.scheduling_strategy
503	        return (self._is_colocation(actor_s) and actor_s.target == "rollout") or (
504	            self._is_colocation(rollout_s) and rollout_s.target == "actor"
505	        )
506	
507	    def _is_v1_awex_colocate(self, config: PPOConfig) -> bool:
508	        """Whether this run is the v1 AWEX colocated actor-rollout setup.
509	
510	        ``weight_update_mode`` alone is not enough: controller v2 selects AWEX
511	        from ``use_lora`` and never reads that field, so a v2 separation run may
512	        legitimately carry ``weight_update_mode="awex"`` and would otherwise
513	        take the v1 colocation handover.
514	
515	        The scheduling strategy is deliberately not part of this check. v1 AWEX
516	        only exists colocated and runs opt in through ``weight_update_mode``
517	        while leaving actor and rollout on the default (separation) strategy;
518	        requiring colocation here skips the meta-server handoff, every training
519	        worker then starts its own server, and the run waits on ``infer_conf``
520	        forever.
521	        """
522	        return (
523	            config.actor._version == "v1" and config.actor.weight_update_mode == "awex"
524	        )

638	    def train(
639	        self,
640	        workflow: WorkflowLike | None = None,
641	        eval_workflow: WorkflowLike | None = None,
642	        workflow_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
643	        eval_workflow_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
644	        dynamic_filter_fn: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], bool] | str | None = None,
645	        total_epochs: int | None = None,
646	    ):
647	        config = self.config
648	        start_step = (
649	            self.recover_info.last_step_info.next().global_step
650	            if self.recover_info is not None
651	            else 0
652	        )
653	
654	        if total_epochs is None:
655	            total_epochs = config.total_train_epochs
656	        if total_epochs <= 0:
657	            raise ValueError(f"Total epochs must be positive: {total_epochs}")
658	        steps_per_epoch = len(self.train_dataloader)
659	        max_steps = total_epochs * steps_per_epoch
660	
661	        # Initialize proxy workers if not using RolloutWorkflow
662	        if workflow is None:
663	            agent_cfg = self.config.rollout.agent
664	            if agent_cfg is not None and agent_cfg.mode == "online":
665	                self._ensure_proxy_started()
666	            else:
667	                raise ValueError(
668	                    "workflow must be specified for train() unless "
669	                    "agent.mode='online' is configured. "
670	                    "Pass a RolloutWorkflow, AgentWorkflow, or callable."
671	                )
672	        elif self._requires_proxy_workflow(workflow):
673	            self._ensure_proxy_started()
674	
675	        for global_step in range(start_step, max_steps):
676	            if (
677	                config.total_train_steps is not None
678	                and global_step >= config.total_train_steps
679	            ):
680	                break
681	            epoch = global_step // steps_per_epoch
682	            step = global_step % steps_per_epoch
683	
684	            if self._should_offload_rollout:
685	                self._onload_rollout()
686	            with (
687	                stats_tracker.record_timing("rollout"),
688	                perf_tracer.trace_scope(
689	                    "train.rollout",
690	                    category=Category.COMPUTE,
691	                    args={
692	                        "global_step": global_step,
693	                        "epoch_step": step,
694	                    },
695	                ),
696	            ):
697	                rollout_batch = self.actor.prepare_batch(
698	                    self.train_dataloader,
699	                    workflow=workflow,
700	                    workflow_kwargs=workflow_kwargs,
701	                    should_accept_fn=dynamic_filter_fn,
702	                    group_size=config.gconfig.n_samples,
703	                    dynamic_bs=self.config.dynamic_bs,
704	                    reward_normalization=config.gconfig.reward_normalization,
705	                    drop_incomplete_group=config.gconfig.drop_incomplete_group,
706	                )
707	            if self._should_offload_rollout:
708	                self._offload_rollout()
709	
710	            if self.critic is not None:
711	                if self._should_offload_critic:
712	                    self._onload_model(self.critic, role="critic")
713	                with (
714	                    stats_tracker.record_timing("critic_values"),
715	                    perf_tracer.trace_scope(
716	                        "train.compute_values",
717	                        category=Category.COMPUTE,
718	                        args={"global_step": global_step},
719	                    ),
720	                ):
721	                    values = self.critic.compute_values(rollout_batch)
722	                    for traj, v in zip(rollout_batch, values):
723	                        traj["values"] = v
724	                    self.critic.get_device_stats().log("critic values")
725	                # Critic stays onloaded — offloaded after ppo_update below
726	
727	            if self.ref is not None:
728	                if self._should_offload_ref:
729	                    self._onload_model(self.ref, role="ref")
730	                with (
731	                    stats_tracker.record_timing("ref_logp"),
732	                    perf_tracer.trace_scope(
733	                        "train.ref_logp",
734	                        category=Category.COMPUTE,
735	                        args={"global_step": global_step},
736	                    ),
737	                ):
738	                    ref_logps = self.ref.compute_logp(rollout_batch)
739	                    for traj, logp in zip(rollout_batch, ref_logps):
740	                        traj["ref_logp"] = logp
741	                    self.ref.get_device_stats().log("ref logp")
742	                if self._should_offload_ref:
743	                    self._offload_model(self.ref, role="ref")
744	
745	            if self.teacher is not None:
746	                if self._should_offload_teacher:
747	                    self._onload_model(self.teacher, role="teacher")
748	                with (
749	                    stats_tracker.record_timing("teacher_logp"),
750	                    perf_tracer.trace_scope(
751	                        "train.teacher_logp",
752	                        category=Category.COMPUTE,
753	                        args={"global_step": global_step},
754	                    ),
755	                ):
756	                    teacher_logps = self.teacher.compute_logp(rollout_batch)
757	                    for traj, logp in zip(rollout_batch, teacher_logps):
758	                        traj["teacher_logp"] = logp
759	                        traj["rl_loss_weight"] = self.config.teacher.rl_loss_weight
760	                        traj["distill_loss_weight"] = (
761	                            self.config.teacher.distill_loss_weight
762	                        )
763	                if self._should_offload_teacher:
764	                    self._offload_model(self.teacher, role="teacher")
765	
766	            # In colocate (awex) mode: switch GPU from inference to training.
767	            # Release SGLang KV cache + weights to free GPU for actor.
768	            if self._is_v1_awex_colocate(self.config):
769	                logger.info("[AWEX] colocate: pausing rollout...")
770	                self.rollout.pause()
771	                logger.info("[AWEX] colocate: pause_generation_sync...")
772	                self.rollout.pause_generation_sync()
773	                logger.info("[AWEX] colocate: offload kv_cache...")
774	                self.rollout.offload(tags=["kv_cache"])
775	                logger.info("[AWEX] colocate: offload weights...")
776	                self.rollout.offload(tags=["weights"])
777	                logger.info("[AWEX] colocate: offload done, onloading actor...")
778	                self.actor.onload()
779	
780	            if self._should_offload_actor:
781	                self._onload_model(self.actor, role="actor")
782	            if config.actor.should_compute_prox_logp():
783	                with (
784	                    stats_tracker.record_timing("recompute_logp"),
785	                    perf_tracer.trace_scope(
786	                        "train.recompute_logp",
787	                        category=Category.COMPUTE,
788	                        args={"global_step": global_step},
789	                    ),
790	                ):
791	                    prox_logps = self.actor.compute_logp(rollout_batch)
792	                    for traj, logp in zip(rollout_batch, prox_logps):
793	                        traj["prox_logp"] = logp
794	                    self.actor.get_device_stats().log("recompute logp")
795	
796	            with (
797	                stats_tracker.record_timing("compute_advantage"),
798	                perf_tracer.trace_scope(

807	            # Wait for async checkpoint staging to complete before modifying parameters

810	            if (

812	                and global_step in config.memory_profiler.profile_steps
813	            ):
814	                self.actor.start_memory_profile(config.memory_profiler.max_entries)

816	            with (
817	                stats_tracker.record_timing("train_step"),
818	                perf_tracer.trace_scope(
819	                    "train.ppo_update",
820	                    category=Category.COMPUTE,
821	                    args={"global_step": global_step},

830	                and global_step in config.memory_profiler.profile_steps
831	            ):
832	                log_dir = StatsLogger.get_log_path(config.stats_logger)
833	                snapshot_dir = os.path.join(

835	                )
836	                os.makedirs(snapshot_dir, exist_ok=True)
837	                self.actor.stop_memory_profile(snapshot_dir)
838	                logger.info(f"Memory snapshots saved to {snapshot_dir}")
839	
840	            if self.critic is not None:
841	                with (
842	                    stats_tracker.record_timing("critic_train_step"),
843	                    perf_tracer.trace_scope(
844	                        "train.critic_ppo_update",
845	                        category=Category.COMPUTE,
846	                        args={"global_step": global_step},
847	                    ),

850	                    self.critic.step_lr_scheduler()
851	                    self.critic.get_device_stats().log("ppo critic update")
852	                if self._should_offload_critic:
853	                    self._offload_model(self.critic, role="critic")
854	
855	            # Save BEFORE update_weights. In AWEX colocate mode the
856	            # transfer ends with actor weights offloaded, so saving afterwards
857	            # would resume weights onto a card already crowded by the
858	            # fully-resumed rollout plus transfer staging leftovers and the HF
859	            # saver's TP coalesced all-gather transient can OOM. Here the
860	            # actor weights are still onloaded from ppo_update (no resume
861	            # needed) and MegatronEngine.save() drops the dead fp32 grad
862	            # buffers to fund the transient. Weights are identical on both
863	            # sides of the transfer, so the checkpoint content is unchanged.
864	            if self._is_v1_awex_colocate(config):
865	                self._save_training_state(
866	                    epoch=epoch,
867	                    epoch_step=step,
868	                    global_step=global_step,
869	                )
870	
871	            # pause inference for updating weights, save, and evaluation
872	            self.rollout.pause()
873	
874	            # Actor already onloaded; engine-internal _offload_aware_context
875	            # calls in update_weights/save are no-ops.
876	
877	            with (
878	                stats_tracker.record_timing("update_weights"),
879	                perf_tracer.trace_scope(
880	                    "train.update_weights",
881	                    category=Category.COMM,
882	                    args={"global_step": global_step},
883	                ),
884	            ):
885	                # Use versioned path for weight updates
886	                new_version = global_step + 1
887	                versioned_meta = self.weight_update_meta.with_version(new_version)
888	                self.actor.update_weights(versioned_meta)
889	
890	                self.actor.set_version(new_version)
891	                if self.critic is not None:
892	                    self.critic.set_version(new_version)
893	                self.rollout.set_version(new_version)
894	                if self.eval_rollout is not None:
895	                    self.eval_rollout.set_version(new_version)
896	
897	            if not self._is_v1_awex_colocate(config):
898	                self._save_training_state(
899	                    epoch=epoch,
900	                    epoch_step=step,
901	                    global_step=global_step,
902	                )
903	
904	            # Offload actor before eval
905	            if self._should_offload_actor:
906	                self._offload_model(self.actor, role="actor")
907	
908	            if self._should_offload_rollout:
909	                self._onload_rollout(is_eval=True)
910	            with (
911	                stats_tracker.record_timing("eval"),
912	                perf_tracer.trace_scope(
913	                    "train.eval",
914	                    category=Category.COMPUTE,
915	                    args={"global_step": global_step},
916	                ),
917	            ):
918	                self._evaluate(
919	                    eval_workflow=eval_workflow,
920	                    eval_workflow_kwargs=eval_workflow_kwargs,
921	                    epoch=epoch,
922	                    epoch_step=step,
923	                    global_step=global_step,
924	                )
925	            if self._should_offload_rollout:
926	                self._offload_rollout(is_eval=True)
927	
928	            with (
929	                stats_tracker.record_timing("clear_batches"),
930	                perf_tracer.trace_scope(
931	                    "train.clear_batches",
932	                    category=Category.INSTR,
933	                    args={"global_step": global_step},
934	                ),
935	            ):
936	                # Each role runs in its own Python process with a
937	                # process-local ``_fetch_buffer``; one HTTP DELETE to the
938	                # storage owner clears ``_storage`` but not per-consumer
939	                # caches. Fan out ``clear_batches`` to every role that
940	                # localized the batch — see areal-project/AReaL#1209.
941	                # SPMD mode never populates ``_fetch_buffer`` (no RTensor
942	                # round-trip), so the fan-out is single-controller only.
943	                if is_single_controller():

947	                    if self.ref is not None:

949	                    if self.data_controller is not None:

951	
952	            with perf_tracer.trace_scope(
953	                "train.log_stats",
954	                category=Category.INSTR,
955	                args={"global_step": global_step},
956	            ):
957	                self._export_and_commit_stats(
958	                    epoch=epoch, epoch_step=step, global_step=global_step
959	                )
960	
961	            # Resume rollout
962	            self.rollout.resume()
963	
964	            self._save_perf_tracer(step=global_step)
